name: tags-name-the-agents-commits

steps.stderr: ws-git: tag 'v1' already exists — ws-git tag -f v1 moves it.
ws-git: 'abcdef0' cannot be a tag name: seven or more hex characters is how a commit id is spelled here, and a word that could be read as either would be neither.
ws-git: 'a..b' is not a tag name: letters, digits or _ to start, then any of . - / as well; no .., and nothing trailing a . or a /.

ws-git: tag takes a name and optionally a commit (try: -f to move a name that is taken, -d to drop one).
usage: ws-git (stage|unstage|commit|reset|status|diff|log|show|checkout|tag|stash|branch|merge|revert|cherry-pick|worktree|sparse-checkout) [...]
supported: stage <paths> (or add <paths> | add -A) | unstage <paths> | commit [-m MSG] | reset | status [--porcelain | -s] | diff [<session>] [--cached] [--check] [--stat] [[--] paths...] | log [<session>] [-n N] [--all] [-S <string>] | show <ref>[:<path>] | checkout <ref> [-- <paths>] | tag [[-f] <name> [<commit>] | -d <name>] | stash [push [-m MSG] | list | pop [stash@{N}] | drop [stash@{N}] | show [stash@{N}]] | branch [<name> [--at <ref>] [--fresh] [--paths <paths>]] | merge (<session> | --abort) | revert <commit> | cherry-pick <session>@<commit> | worktree (add <dir> <session>[@<commit>] | <tag> | list | remove <dir>) | sparse-checkout [list] | help

summary: tag bookmarks a commit, lists, moves with -f, drops with -d, and is a ref the other verbs read; the log shows it.
